import { Component } from '@angular/core'; import { Router } from '@angular/router'; import { AuthService } from '@app/auth/services/auth.service'; import { Observable } from 'rxjs'; @Component({ selector: 'app-header', templateUrl: './header.component.html', styleUrls: ['./header.component.scss'] }) export class HeaderComponent { isAuthorized$: Observable; constructor(private authService: AuthService, private router: Router) { this.isAuthorized$ = this.authService.isAuthorized$; } onAuthButtonClick() { if (this.authService.isAuthorized) { this.authService.logout(); this.router.navigate(['/login']); } else { this.router.navigate(['/login']); } } }
